data.name: LA TOUBANA HÔTEL & SPA
data.description:
Set on a rocky hillside overlooking the Caribbean Sea, this upscale hotel is 13 km from Domaine de Valombreuse Park.
The airy bungalows feature carved-wood furnishings and come with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and kitchenettes. All include furnished terraces with sea views. Split-level suites include Nespresso machines and separate living rooms with pull-out sofas. Upgraded suites have private pools. Children age 2 and under stay free with an adult. Private villas are available.
The hotel has 2 restaurants (1 at the beach), and a pool bar at the outdoor infinity pool overlooking the sea. Other amenities include a chic spa and a gym.
